q: how many book titles and copies are in the library
ref: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookcatalog), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookaccessionmaster)

q: how many books are currently issued
ref: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CircIssueTransaction WHERE status = 'Issued'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookaccessionmaster WHERE CheckStatus = 'A'

q: how many overdue books are there
ref: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CircIssueTransaction WHERE status = 'Issued' AND duedate < CAST(GETDATE() AS date)

SELECT TOP 5 bc.title, COUNT(*) c FROM CircIssueTransaction it JOIN bookaccessionmaster am ON it.accno = am.accessionnumber JOIN bookcatalog bc ON am.ctrl_no = bc.ctrl_no GROUP BY bc.title ORDER BY c DESC

q: how many members have expired membership
ref: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CircUserManagement WHERE validupto < CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CircIssueTransaction WHERE CAST(issuedate AS date) = CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
SELECT tc.ContentType, COUNT(*) FROM DigitalContent dc JOIN TypeOfContent tc ON dc.ContentTypeId = tc.Id GROUP BY tc.ContentType
